purpose: Independent preregistered plans, not started experiments. No active worker is required to read this directory. Each plan contains local method and controls; primary papers serve verification, not prerequisites to implement the mechanism screen.
audit_firewall: Source/task IDs and all synthetic task definitions split before training. Dev chooses config. Fresh identities/labels and heldout pair/architecture combinations are never used for tuning. Any peek invalidates fresh result.
decision: A five-world fresh gate is screening evidence only; ADOPTED requires separate independent replication with >=10 seed/task units and measurements on a real workload if relevant.
threshold_note: Numerical tolerances and relative thresholds below are preregistered research choices, not claims from the cited papers.
files: Plans under research_intake only do not constitute an active experiment directory, RESULTS_CORE.csv or VERIFICATION.json. Promote to experiment template only by explicit user decision.
source_check: Freeze exact model commit, tokenizer, pretrained checkpoint hash, random seed, software versions, dtype, GPU and batch before results.
